concerns.text: Task T020-impl (schema definition for covariates) is listed as a dependency for T013 (data collection interface), but T020-impl is placed AFTER T013 in the task list and marked incomplete. T013 cannot be implemented or tested without the schema definition from T020-impl being complete first. This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule.

Task T014 (logic to ensure distinct consecutive images, exclude partial sessions) is listed as a dependency for T013's output schema consistency, but T014 is placed AFTER T013. T013 describes the output schema, but T014 defines the critical logic for data exclusion (FR-001 Edge Cases) that determines what data actually enters that schema. The exclusion logic must be defined/implemented before the collection interface can be considered complete and testable.

Task T028-impl (outlier detection logic) is a prerequisite for T028-exec (execute sensitivity analysis), but T028-exec is listed immediately after T028-impl without a clear dependency marker or separation. More critically, T028-impl is marked [P] (parallel-safe), but it depends on the LME model fitting (T025) to have a dataset to analyze. T025 is not marked as a dependency for T028-impl, creating a hidden ordering violation where the consumer (outlier detection) might run before the producer (LME model/data preparation) is ready.

Phase 7 tasks (T035-exec, T036-exec, T037-exec) are marked as dependent on Phase 0 (results exist) and Phase 2 (validation logic). However, T037-exec (gate_launch.py) is the mechanism that BLOCKS study launch. The tasks in Phase 3 (US1) and Phase 4 (US2) are data collection tasks. The ordering implies data collection (Phase 3/4) can happen before the gate (Phase 7) is executed. The gate MUST be executed BEFORE any data collection (Phase 3/4) begins, not after. The dependency graph is inverted for the critical launch gate.

Task T006 (Configure linting) is marked incomplete and placed in Phase 1 (Setup), but it is not listed as a dependency for any subsequent task. While not a hard ordering violation, it should be explicitly marked as a prerequisite for T005 (Initialize Python project) or T007 (Create directory structure) to ensure code quality standards are met before any code is written, aligning with the 'Foundational tasks first' principle.
